# Introduction to the SRD 5.2 (2024)

Welcome to the **D&D 5e System Reference Document 5.2** (2024 revision). This manual contains the core game rules for publishing your own D&D 5th Edition content under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC BY 4.0).

## What is the SRD?

The **System Reference Document** is the official subset of game rules and content released by Wizards of the Coast under an open license. The 5.2 revision (published in 2024 alongside the updated *Player's Handbook*) updates terminology, balance, and class design while keeping the core 5e engine intact.

## What's in this manual

This application packages the SRD 5.2 as a structured manual that can power player characters, monsters, spells, classes, races, feats, traits, and backgrounds in your campaigns. The data is available in two languages:

- **English** (original SRD)
- **Spanish** (*SRD_CC_v5.2.1*, official translation)

Switch the application language in the top bar — the manual viewer and every game-data endpoint will switch automatically to the corresponding language.

## How to use this manual in a campaign

1. When creating or configuring a campaign, pick this manual (`D&D 5e SRD 5.2 (2024)`) as the active system.
2. Class pages, the spell list, the bestiary, the race catalog, the feats, traits, and backgrounds are all populated from this manual.
3. From each detail page you can **Copy to my campaign** to materialize the entry as a campaign-specific record that you can edit and customize without losing the link back to the source manual.
